segments.text: the actual core missions are genuinely cinema. The story is good, it's developing at a good pace
and the world is immersive. I wasn't well immersed into the world because it was hurting my eyes
to look at the grass and look at the ground. I actually kind of hated looking around while
driving it because I was getting a headache because of the frame rate, it's so bad. But
30 FPS going down from 30 into the 20s is crazy. Dude, you can't see nothing.
